title: Chapter 634 - 634 Hello, Mr. Lin; How Should We Deal With This?!
content:
Chapter 634 - 634 Hello, Mr. Lin; How Should We Deal With This?!

Chapter 634 - 634 Hello, Mr. Lin; How Should We Deal With This?!

634 Hello, Mr. Lin; How Should We Deal With This?!

The originally quiet and peaceful 365th floor of the Imperial Hotel quickly became noisy.

The atmosphere was so tense that one could cut it with a knife.

The waiter did not expect this to happen.

When he heard Fang Wenjie’s words, his face turned pale and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.

Fang Wenjie was the young master of the Fang family, and his status was very impressive.

Lin Fan was the most distinguished guest that General Manager Wang You had personally instructed him to serve well.

Neither side could be easily offended.

…

In the live broadcast room.

Big Guai: [F*ck! Awesome! He actually made a move!]

Ruyan of the Past: [He was sent flying with a casual palm strike. Could the guy be a special ability user? Moreover, he’s a very powerful special ability user!]

M: [It’s over. Mr. Lin is finished. Xia Xue is finished too!] Special ability users are indeed powerful, but the Fang family has them too!]

123 Wooden Man: [The Fang family’s power is unimaginable. This young man… is a little impulsive.]

Four Seasons Like Spring: [I want to say that he did a good job! However, my rationality tells me that he shouldn’t have picked a fight.]

Menlo: [Xia Xue, be careful.]

Pi: [Even the Fang family can’t attack people casually, right?]

M: [Yes, they can’t make a move casually, but as long as they find a good enough reason, it’ll be easy.]

…

Xia Xue was also scared by the atmosphere of the scene. Her pretty face gradually turned pale, and she did not know what to do.

Lin Fan patted Xia Xue’s shoulder and smiled. “Don’t worry, it’ll be fine.”

These words seemed to have a magical power that made her feel extremely relaxed.

At this moment, the VIP elevator not far away rang softly.

Then, a large group of men and women in suits and white shirts walked over quickly.

They were from the Wang family.

When everyone arrived at the private room and saw Lin Fan…

They bowed in unison and said in an extremely sincere and excited voice, “Greetings, Mr. Lin.”

This scene shocked the waiter and Xia Xue.

The waiter had seen many members of the Wang family.

In addition, not long ago, he had learned from Wang You’s phone call that Lin Fan was a very distinguished guest.

However, he did not expect Wang You to bring over all the core members of the Wang family… Among them, even Wang Qianjin and Wang Zhihai had rushed over. They bowed to Lin Fan and greeted him.

They were Wang Qianjin and Wang Zhihai!

This was simply unbelievable!

Xia Xue, on the other hand, was at a loss.

Although she did not know anyone from the Wang family, just from their temperament, she could feel that they were all extraordinary.

There were so many people, including many elders… They bowed toward Lin Fan.

Lin Fan… was still so young.

What was his identity?

…

In the live broadcast room.

Little Ming: [Can someone tell me what happened here?]

Song: [This… Why are there suddenly so many people here?]

In My imagination: [F*ck! That seems to be Wang You! Wang You is the general manager of the Imperial Hotel! He actually bowed to Mr. Lin? Heavens! Who is he?]

Feng Zhong: [It’s not just Wang You! Do you see the two old men in front of him? If I’m not wrong, they should be the previous heads of the Wang family, Wang Qianjin and Wang Zhihai. At the same time, they’re also the former general managers of the Imperial Hotel!]

Super Dreamer: [Does anyone know who this young man is?]

Love You for Ten Thousand Years: [I don’t know why, but I feel like I met a big shot today!]

…

In fact, not only the waiter and Xia Xue were shocked.

Fang Wenjie, who was lying on the ground, was also stunned.

He had never seen Wang Zhihai and Wang Qianjin, but he had seen Wang Dakai, who was standing at the back, and Wang You, the general manager of the Imperial Hotel.

They all bowed and greeted Lin Fan?

Who exactly was Lin Fan?

At this moment, the gorgeous woman standing at the side said, “Brother Wenjie, are your injuries serious? That person is detestable!

“You’re the young master of the Fang family. He actually dared to hit you directly.

“Brother Wenjie, you must teach him a lesson.”

Then, she looked at the Wang family members who were still bowing at Lin Fan and said, “Brother Wenjie, there are so many of them. Should we call the Fang family now?”

The gorgeous woman obviously did not know Wang You and the others. She just thought that they were Lin Fan’s subordinates.

However, she was not afraid.

For a gorgeous woman to have more than 20 million fans, she could be considered to have experienced some things.

At the same time, she was also very clear about how powerful the Fang family was.

Otherwise, she would not have spent so much effort to hook up with Fang Wenjie.

In the eyes of the gorgeous woman, no matter how many people Lin Fan had in front of him, it was useless. They could not compare to the Fang family at all.

After Fang Wenjie heard the gorgeous woman’s words, he slowly recovered from the shock in his heart.

That was right.

Lin Fan was the one who made the first move.

Even if he really did have some background, he would still have the advantage.

Moreover, his Fang family might not be afraid of the other party.

In addition, if he did not do anything, the other party would probably think that he was afraid.

Besides, he had a woman beside him.

No matter what, he could not lose face in front of a woman.

Thinking of this, Fang Wenjie’s tone became high again. He shouted at the top of his voice, “General Manager Wang, I was beaten up at your hotel. Shouldn’t you give me an explanation first?”

Lin Fan looked at Fang Wenjie with interest.

Everyone from the Wang family seemed to have sensed Lin Fan’s gaze.

Hence, they all turned to look at Fang Wenjie, who was lying on the ground.

“Who are you?” Wang You asked with a frown. “Why are you here?”

That was because he had already instructed the staff to clear all 365 floors to entertain Lin Fan.

Faced with so many gazes, Fang Wenjie felt inexplicably nervous.

He gritted his teeth and replied, “I’m Fang Wenjie. My father is the chairman of Dafang Group, Fang Zhong.”

Fang Zhong’s name seemed to bring Fang Wenjie endless strength, making him feel much more relaxed.

Fang Wenjie continued, “My girlfriend and I want to eat Deep Sea Golden Gall and Giant Scorpion, but your hotel only has one serving of them left. Moreover, they were reserved by this young man.

“Therefore, I went upstairs to buy the Deep Sea Golden Gall and the Giant Scorpion at twice the price.

“Also, I offered 100,000 World Coins for his private room.

“I think I was being reasonable.

“In the end, he didn’t agree. He even asked me to get lost. After that, he beat me up with a palm strike.

“General Manager Wang, how should your hotel handle this matter?!”
